# viettelcloud_vdc (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud vDC, a group of compute hosts in one zone that an operator reserves for the project, by ID, name, region, or zone. A vDC without a zone cannot be read. A lookup by `name` without `region` or `zone` can also fail when the name of such a vDC contains the configured name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup vDC by ID
data "viettelcloud_vdc" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup vDC by Name and Zone
data "viettelcloud_vdc" "by_name_and_zone" {
  name = "example-vdc"
  zone = "vn-central-1a"
}

# Lookup vDC by Name and Region
data "viettelcloud_vdc" "by_name_and_region" {
  name   = "example-vdc"
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) vDC ID (UUID). Exactly one vDC must match.
- `name` (String) vDC name to filter by. Names are matched exactly and are not unique.
- `region` (String) Region name of the vDC to filter by.
- `zone` (String) Zone name of the vDC to filter by. The zone must exist in the project.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) vDC description. Null when the vDC has none.
- `ratio` (Number) Overcommit ratio of the vDC, from 0 to 4. It does not scale `stats[*].total`.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID) of the vDC.
- `stats` (Attributes List) Resource usage of the vDC, in the order ram, cpus, gpus, servers. The values change on every refresh. `total` is the physical capacity, not multiplied by `ratio`, so `used` can be greater than `total`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stats))
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID) of the vDC.

<a id="nestedatt--stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stats`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Display label of the resource.
- `name` (String) Resource key: ram, cpus, gpus, or servers.
- `total` (Number) Physical capacity. ram and gpus are in GiB. For servers it is -1, which means no limit.
- `unit` (String) Unit of `used` and `total`, or null when the resource has no unit.
- `used` (Number) Amount in use. ram and gpus are in GiB, and gpus counts GPU memory, not GPUs.
